data.one_liner: Kotlin standard library port for Dart and Flutter with 150+ collection methods.
data.what_it_does: It brings Kotlin-style standard library collections like KtList, KtMap, and KtSet to Dart, providing immutable-by-default collections, deep equals comparisons, and 150+ functional methods.
use_when: You prefer Kotlin's collection API and want immutable collections by default
You need deep equals out-of-the-box for complex nested collections
You are porting Kotlin codebases or logic directly to Dart
avoid_when: You prefer sticking strictly to standard Dart core collections and syntax
You are sensitive to introducing third-party collection wrappers over native Lists and Maps
strengths: Comprehensive port of Kotlin standard library with 150+ methods
Immutable collections by default preventing accidental mutations
Deep equals comparison out of the box
weaknesses: Requires converting between native Dart collections and kt_dart collections
Collections do not directly implement standard Dart Iterable, requiring .iter or .asList
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import 'package:kt_dart/kt.dart'.
